name: Everything it reaches
blurb: gh, git over HTTPS and the GitHub API, on whatever the token itself reaches.
guide: The token's own permissions and repositories are the limit: GitHub enforces them, whatever this grant says.
Narrow it further with an attribute, github.repository = owner/name, or start from One repository.

fields.purpose: GitHub: gh, git over HTTPS and the GitHub API, as far as the token reaches.
